title: LiveChatObjectAccessConfig - Data API
description: Represents the action you can perform on a specified object by the Chat API. This object is available in API version 53.0 and later.

AccessType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
AccessType.description: The API action you can perform on the object specified in SobjectType. Possible values are: Create Find

ParentId.description: The ID of the associated LiveChatObjectAccessDefinition record. This is a relationship field.

SobjectType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
SobjectType.description: The object that the action specified by AccessType applies to. Possible values are all standard and custom objects. Custom objects are available as picklist values in API version 55.0 and later.

special_access_rules: To access this object, enable Chat. To see the list of objects you can find or create in the UI using this API, enable the "Turns on findOrCreate in chat API" permission. You can find this permission in the Chat Settings page of the Setup UI.

Id.field_label: Live Chat Object Access Configuration ID

ParentId.field_label: Live Chat Object Access Definition ID
